An '''administration building''' was located within the [[Eastern Enrichment Zone]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. It was used by the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]], a branch of the [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Jedi Service Corps]] tasked with managing the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order's]] agricultural research. The [[Meerian/Legends|Meerian]] [[RonTha]] worked there<ref name="TDR" /> in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]'' to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].</ref> The building was connected to the [[Enrichment Dome]] used by the AgriCorps to grow the [[Plant/Legends|plants]] needed for their research.<ref name="TDR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The main administration building was featured in the [[1999]] young adult novel ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]'', the second book in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] series. ''The Dark Rival'' was written by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="TDR" />
